GLM 5.3 Flash now available on AI Gateway - Vercel Skip to content Copy Wordmark Copy Logo Download Brand Assets Brand Guidelines Get a Demo Log In Sign Up Ask AI Dashboard Products Agent Stack AI SDK AI Gateway Sandbox Passport Connect eve Core Platform Security Content Delivery Fluid Compute Observability Workflows CI/CD Tools Next.js Vercel Agent Vercel Plugin Open Source Domains ↗ v0 ↗ Resources Learn Docs About Blog Changelog Knowledge Base Build AI Apps Web Apps Marketing Sites Platforms Commerce Explore Customers Marketplace Partner Finder AWS Community ↗ Enterprise Pricing Get a Demo Log In Sign Up GLM 5.3 Flash now available on AI Gateway Zachary Chen , Jerilyn Zheng Blog Changelog 26 Aug 2026 1 min read Copy GLM 5.3 Flash from Z.ai is now available on AI Gateway as zai/glm-5.3-flash . GLM 5.3 Flash is a multimodal coding model with a 1M-token context window. It accepts both text and image inputs and supports function calling, structured output, and streaming. 1 import { streamText } from 'ai' ; 2 3 const result = streamText ( { 4 model : 'zai/glm-5.3-flash' , 5 prompt : 'Build a responsive React dashboard with a collapsible sidebar.' , 6 } ) ; Stream a response from GLM 5.3 Flash through AI Gateway. To include images, pass them with text in a message. A request can include multiple images using URLs, Base64 data URLs, or binary data: 1 import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs' ; 2 import { streamText } from 'ai' ; 3 4 const result = streamText ( { 5 model : 'zai/glm-5.3-flash' , 6 messages : [ 7 { 8 role : 'user' , 9 content : [ 10 { 11 type : 'text' , 12 text : 'Recreate this screenshot as a responsive React component.' , 13 } , 14 { 15 type : 'file' , 16 mediaType : 'image/png' , 17 data : readFileSync ( 'screenshot.png' ) , 18 } , 19 ] , 20 } , 21 ] , 22 } ) ; Send an image and text to GLM 5.3 Flash. To use GLM 5.3 Flash with a coding agent, run vercel ai-gateway coding-agents setup , then select zai/glm-5.3-flash as your agent's model. Try GLM 5.3 Flash in the model playground , or browse all language models . Loading status… Select a display theme: system light dark
